// diagnostic

E0513

The condition reads `{name}`, but nothing in the loop changes `{name}` before the next turn

What

The condition reads `{name}`, but nothing in the loop changes `{name}` before the next turn

Why

The header binding is set once, before the first turn; when neither the body nor the step writes it, every turn tests the same value, so the loop never ends or never starts

Fix

Change `{name}` in the body or in a step, as in `loop i := 0, i < n, i += 1`; read repeated input with `loop line in io.stdin().lines()`; or stop from the body with `if test { break }`
